name: US Census Bureau Data API
capabilities: Official structured geographic/statistical data API. Current examples require an API key for all data queries; dataset/variable documentation is public.

query.authentication: Official examples page states all data queries now require an API key. No credential provisioned or used.
query.request_shape_verified: documentation only; no item queries executed
query.paging: Geographic predicates; pagination untested. Do not invent page/offset parameters.

licensing: Metadata and content rights remain separate and unverified unless specified below.
limitations: No current item query examples. Documentation responses are not qualified origins.
No country-specific access or complete language coverage established.
next_action: Revisit when an already-authorized Census API credential is available, or official policy documents a keyless dataset route. Continue other sources meanwhile; no account creation or owner action needed to continue the program.
